issues.explanation: This contains the personal name 曹腾 plus the noun 养子, so grouping it as one word hides both useful segments.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 曹腾 (name) and 养子 (word, adopted son).

issues.explanation: Here 字 introduces Cao Cao's courtesy name, not the meaning “letter.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “styled; courtesy name.”

issues.explanation: In 善权谋, 善 means to be skilled at or good at, not simply “good.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “be skilled at.”

issues.explanation: Here 曾 is the adverb “once,” not the surname Zeng.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “once; previously.”

issues.explanation: In 装病, 装 means to pretend or feign, not adornment.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “pretend; feign.”

issues.explanation: 举孝廉 is a historical action phrase whose key lexical term 孝廉 is split into individual characters, hiding the useful term for a recommended filial and incorrupt candidate.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 举 as “recommend,” and segment 孝廉 together with an appropriate historical gloss.

issues.explanation: 任洛阳北部尉 uses 任 as the verb “be appointed to/serve as,” not the surname Ren.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “be appointed to; serve as.”

issues.explanation: 尉 is an official title here, not a person's surname.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark as a word/title, with pinyin wèi and a gloss such as “commandant; military official.”

issues.explanation: In 以五色棒严惩, 以 introduces the instrument used, not the abbreviation for Israel.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “with; using.”

issues.explanation: 棒 is the noun “stick/staff” in 五色棒, not a grammatical particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark as a word/noun.

issues.explanation: 大震 is not a standalone idiom here; it is the verbal part of the ordinary phrase 威名大震.
issues.suggested_fix: Mark 大震 as a word, or segment the phrase compositionally without an idiom label.

issues.explanation: After 到颍川, 后 is the temporal particle/word “after,” not the surname Hou.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “after; afterward.”

issues.explanation: 奉命 uses 奉 in the sense “receive/act under” an order, not “offer.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “receive; follow” in the phrase 奉命.

issues.explanation: In 奉命, 命 means an order or command, not “life.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “order; command.”

issues.explanation: 左丰 is a personal name and should not be split into two ordinary-word entries.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 左丰 together as the name Lú? Correction: the name is Zuǒ Fēng; use pinyin Zuǒ Fēng and an appropriate name gloss.

issues.explanation: 被 introduces the passive construction 被诬陷, not the noun “quilt.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as a passive marker, “be; get.”

issues.explanation: In 董卓击败……时, 时 means “when,” not the surname Shi.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “when; at the time that.”

issues.explanation: 救 means rescue or save in this context; the current gloss provides no usable learner meaning.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “rescue; save.”

issues.explanation: 轻慢 is a lexicalized word meaning to treat someone disrespectfully or contemptuously; splitting it into 轻 and 慢 with unrelated literal glosses materially misleads the learner.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 轻慢 together and gloss as “treat with contempt; slight.”

issues.explanation: 无礼 is a natural word meaning discourteous or impolite; splitting it into 无 and 礼 hides the useful word and gives incorrect local meanings.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 无礼 together and gloss as “rude; discourteous.”

issues.explanation: 要杀 means “want/intend to kill,” not “demand” in the current bound-form gloss.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “want to; intend to” here.

issues.explanation: 劝止 means urge someone to stop, especially stop an action; “dissuade from stopping” reverses the meaning.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss as “urge to stop; dissuade from doing it.”

issues.explanation: In the stock cliffhanger 留待下回分解, 分解 means explain or reveal what happened, not simply resolve.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss locally as “explain; reveal the outcome.”
